name: GitHub HTML Preview
description: Adds a Preview button next to .html files on GitHub (blob view, PR diffs, commits) that renders them in a sandboxed tab.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals allow-downloads; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src * data: blob:; font-src * data:; media-src * data: blob:; connect-src *; frame-src *; child-src *;
